stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r. (A) √3 cosθ + sin x = √2 has general solution x = pnπ + rπ/12 or x = pnπ + π/q, where n ∈ Z. (B) The general solution of the trigonometric equation sin³θ cosθ − cos³θ sinθ = 1/4 is θ = nπ/p + rπ/q, where n ∈ Z. (C) If 0 < x < π and cos x + sin x = 1/2 then tan x is (r − √p)/q, where r, p, q are least natural numbers. (D) If α and β are two distinct values of θ lying between 0 and 2π satisfying the equation 3cosθ + 4sinθ = 2, then the value of sin(α+β) is p/q, then p, q, r = p + q, −p/q = 24/25.
reason: Four-part question with separate answers; part (A) mixes θ and x, part (C) needs r = −4 though 'natural numbers' is printed, and part (D)'s '−p/q = 24/25' contradicts sin(α+β) = p/q = +24/25.
